profile.summary: Alec321 demonstrates specialized expertise in JavaScript ecosystem infrastructure rather than application development. Their contributions focus on npm security, dependency management, and vulnerability resolution within the lodash repository. While not directly writing JavaScript code, their work involves critical aspects of the JavaScript toolchain—particularly around package integrity, dependency hygiene, and security policy enforcement. This profile suggests a strong background in DevSecOps, open-source maintenance, or dependency scanning rather than traditional frontend/backend development.
